the spatial coherence and polarization of surface-plasmon fields can be controlled by the film thickness, frequency of operation, and media, and that the two-mode fields can be highly polarized or partially polarized.

the coherence and polarization of the two-mode surface-plamon polariton field at an ultra-thin film are strongly influenced by the film thickness, the frequency, and the dielectric properties of the surrounding media, with the possibility of achieving coherence lengths extending from the subwavelength scale up to thousands of optical wavelengths and a partial polarization that can be as high as 0.8.

the spatial coherence and polarization properties of a superposition of two surface-plasmon-polariton modes at a metallic nanofilms are strongly dependent on the film thickness and the frequency and that the coherence and polarization can be manipulated by the choice of the media.

the two-mode surface-plasm polariton field can be highly coherent and highly polarized at the excitation region and can be highly coherent but partially polarized at a close vicinity of the excitation region.
